reviews.name: Kedar Jamkar
reviews.text: I recently purchased my laptop from Orion Computers, and I'm extremely happy with the experience. Their customer support is very humble and responsive, always ready to help. They offered me a very good price, better than what I found elsewhere. The owner personally attended me, which made the whole process smooth and trustworthy. After-sales support is quick and genuine, which builds confidence.

reviews.name: kavita mane
reviews.text: I'm very happy with my new PC build. All components were properly installed and cable management is clean. The system boots fast, runs smoothly, and handles gaming and daily work without any lag. Temperatures are stable and noise levels are low. Overall, a solid and well-balanced build. Great value for money.

reviews.name: Gaurang Wadhwa
reviews.text: Excellent service! They were very supportive and patiently helped me choose the right configuration for my requirements. The desktop was assembled quickly and works perfectly. Really happy with the overall experience.

reviews.name: Ulhas Patki
reviews.text: Excellent service! I had several lab PCs repaired at Orion Computer Nanded. Being in the CS field, I appreciate their transparency in diagnosing hardware faults and their use of genuine components. The turnaround time was impressive, and the systems are running perfectly. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Shubham Sharan
reviews.text: I went here for my laptop repair and had an excellent experience. They helped me quickly, used genuine parts, and the repair charges were very reasonable. Their experienced engineers are very knowledgeable and quickly identified the real issue with my laptop and fixed it in no time. I highly recommend Orion Computer to everyone.
